ci.step: Verify real API, durable worker and downloaded files

evidence.limitations: Real API, PostgreSQL, Redis, worker and saved files. Exercises upload, findings, remediation, approval, fresh reads and exact downloads, including unavailable AI and withheld output. The LaTeX corpus has 26 cases and 28 source files, each run as an original and explicitly authored-language variant: 20 exact TEX downloads, 28 single-file refusals, two no-ops and two intact-project scan/refusal journeys. A separate HTML-only queue lane covers all 26 case IDs; a compiler gate checks 26 original contexts, 26 authored-language contexts and all 20 downloaded TEX files. These are bounded saved-artifact checks, with no dashboard interaction, domain-human or assistive-technology review, rendered or spoken math fidelity proof, or accessibility conformance proof.

ci.step: Run the journeys through the dashboard

evidence.limitations: Real dashboard, API, PostgreSQL, Redis and durable worker with no AI provider. A PDF is taken from upload to download using only the keyboard; a DOCX goes through review, approval and a reload; a DOCX with a picture and no vision model is delivered with the picture still unresolved. Downloaded bytes are compared with the recorded receipt, read back with poppler and unzip, and uploaded again as a new scan. An image-heavy PPTX must be withheld with every picture left for review and no description written. axe runs on every page visited and fails on serious or critical violations. One PDF, one DOCX and one PPTX only; no cloud storage or LMS publish-back, no assistive-technology review, no semantic fidelity or accessibility conformance proof.
